article.title: Dominican Republic becomes latest Latin American country to adopt IHRA antisemitism definition amid regional shift to the right
article.author: Simón Rodríguez
article.content: Adopting the IHRA definition of antisemitism has become a marker of Latin America's rightward shift, as governments across the region align with Israeli foreign policy and move to criminalize solidarity with Palestine.
